invalid_target.message: Invalid target: {target}. Notifications and speakers are allowed.

no_entities.message: No entities selected. Fill in entities or selection.

unknown_tts_engine.message: Text to speech engine not found: {engine}.

no_tts_engine.message: Speakers need a text to speech engine, but none is set up.

announce.name: Announce states
announce.description: Checks entities and announces which of them have a given state. The message goes to notifications or is spoken on speakers.

entities.name: Entities
entities.description: Individually selected entities. Checked in this order and without filters.

selection.name: Selection
selection.description: Floors, areas, devices or labels. Evaluated on every run, so new entities are included automatically.

device_classes.name: Device class
device_classes.description: Only check entities of the selection with this device class.

domains.name: Entity type
domains.description: Only check entities of the selection of this type.

state.name: State
state.description: State or number to look for. Custom values like home, open or 20 can be entered.

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.description: How the state is compared. Above and below only apply to numbers, e.g. battery below 20.

message_one.name: Message for one match
message_one.description: Empty: the message for multiple matches is used.

message_many.name: Message for multiple matches
message_many.description: Placeholders: names and count in curly braces.

targets.name: Targets
targets.description: Notifications, notification services or speakers. Multiple allowed.

name_source.name: Name source
name_source.description: Source of the names in the message.

tts_engine.name: Text to speech engine
tts_engine.description: For speaker targets. Empty: the first available engine.

title.name: Title
title.description: Notification title, if the target supports one.

alexa_type.name: Alexa output
alexa_type.description: Only for Alexa Media Player targets.

report_unavailable.name: Report unavailable
report_unavailable.description: Append unavailable entities to the message.
